definition: Q8 default: Core80 / Expanded LVT20 / Def200 Cash. This is identical to Pure_LVT_Satellite by construction.
Core80 / Def200 Cash plus 20% Expanded LVT satellite.
Core80 / Def200 Cash plus 20% Expanded SuperTrend satellite; same Expanded pool and same satellite budget; no ST asset means satellite cash.
LVT names can enter only when SuperTrend is long; existing LVT names may remain until LVT drops them.
LVT names are removed once an already-held name is SuperTrend short; new LVT names are not entry-gated.
LVT-selected and ST-long names keep normal LVT weights; LVT-selected but ST-short names are cut to half weight, with freed weight to cash.
LVT-selected but ST-short names are fully moved to cash without redistributing to other satellite names.
Upper-reference filter: only names passing both LVT and SuperTrend receive satellite allocation, re-normalized to the satellite budget.
